episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Dr. Billy Wayne Ruddick Jr. interviews Bernie Sanders, Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello dines with a South Carolina Trump delegate and her husband, Rick Sherman tries to get representation for his artwork at a gallery in Laguna Beach, CA and Col. Erran Morad enlists a gun rights advocate in his campaign to arm schoolchildren.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Capt. Erran Morad teaches Georgia State Representative Jason Spencer how to spot terrorists wearing burkas, Gio Monaldo enlists The Bachelor contestant Corinne Olympios for an Ebola charity, Dr. Billy Wayne Ruddick Jr. interviews Ted Koppel, Col. Erran Morad meets with Dick Cheney and Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello conducts a public hearing in Kingman, AZ.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Erran Morad interviews Alabama Senate Candidate Roy Moore and recruits Trump supporters to go undercover at a Mexican quinceañera party, and Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello talks to former South Carolina state legislator Chip Limehouse and rapper Bone Crusher.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Sgt. Erran Morad teaches Alabama Trump delegate Shaun McCutcheon what to do during a terrorist attack at the workplace, Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello interviews Utah Republican leader David Pyne about a children's book, Gio Monaldo tries to buy a yacht and OMGWhizBoyOMG invites special guest former Maricopa County, AZ sheriff Joe Arpiao to his show.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Rick Sherman introduces his tracks to a Miami DJ, Dr. Billy Wayne Ruddick Jr. interviews Trump campaign manager Corey Lewandowski, Gio Monaldo photographs an internet entrepreneur, OMGWhizBoyOMG does some unboxing with a Milwaukee sheriff and Brig. Erran Morad teaches pro-gun advocate Dan Roberts how to handle a terrorist attack.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Dr. Billy Wayne Ruddick Jr. interviews Jill Stein and Director of the National Institutes of Health Dr. Francis Collins, Sgt. Corp. Erran Morad visits the home of Real Housewife of Orange County Gretchen Rossi, Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello simulates childbirth and Rick Sherman cooks for a food critic.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Dr. Billy Wayne Ruddick Jr. interviews former Massachusetts congressman Barney Frank and Lt. Erran Morad recruits an assistant to foil a liberal terrorist plot at the San Francisco Women's March.
